project.register_purpose: Single machine-readable authority, source, closure, and physical-claim gate for GAP-01 through GAP-04.

review.review_scope: REP-03 local contracts, the local position-based task plan, and the 23 October 2026 Drive literature set.

policy.closure_rule: A gap may become CLOSED only when every closure criterion is PASS and every required source is AVAILABLE_VERIFIED, closure-capable, authority-matched, versioned, and SHA-256 pinned.

sources.title: REP-03 Codex Görev Planı Pozisyon Bazlı v1
sources.limitation: Defines the planned WF-03-06 host ACK and shutdown-flow semantics. It does not identify the Raspberry Pi model, approve the host protocol, set electrical timing, or prove physical shutdown behavior.

sources.title: 23.10.2026 — Power Rail, Automotive Interfaces ve DART Sim | Kapsamlı Literatür Taraması
sources.limitation: General research synthesis only. It may inform questions and review checklists but cannot select an exact part, replace an OEM or client requirement, or close a gap.

sources.title: Basic Calculation of a Buck Converter's Power Stage
sources.limitation: Generic buck power-stage sizing guidance. It is not an OEM transient profile, an exact selected-IC datasheet, a loop-compensation source, or physical evidence.

sources.title: AN-932 Power Supply Sequencing
sources.limitation: General power-sequencing guidance. It does not define REP-03 host ACK semantics, the Raspberry Pi model, exact thresholds, or a project-approved power-down protocol.

sources.title: AN-1311 Complex Power Supply Sequencing Made Easy
sources.limitation: General sequencing architecture guidance. It cannot substitute for the selected parts, OEM limits, client-approved shutdown behavior, or measured evidence.

sources.title: Required CAN and LIN transceiver closure evidence
sources.owner: REP-03 hardware decision owner and client
sources.limitation: Placeholder for the approved exact CAN and LIN transceiver parts, manufacturer datasheets and errata, and project mapping. Missing evidence keeps GAP-01 BLOCKED.

sources.title: Required GNSS module, antenna, and RF closure evidence
sources.owner: REP-03 RF decision owner and client
sources.limitation: Placeholder for the exact GNSS module and antenna, authoritative integration sources, and project RF-feed and layout review. Missing evidence keeps GAP-02 BLOCKED.

sources.title: Required OEM transient and exact power-path closure evidence
sources.owner: Client or vehicle OEM requirement owner and REP-03 power decision owner
sources.limitation: Placeholder for approved vehicle/OEM transient profiles, exact power-path parts, datasheets and errata, and project limits. Missing evidence keeps GAP-03 BLOCKED.

sources.title: Required Raspberry Pi model and host shutdown closure evidence
sources.owner: Client and REP-03 host-integration decision owner
sources.limitation: Placeholder for the exact Raspberry Pi model/revision, platform power requirements, and client-approved host shutdown and ACK protocol. Missing evidence keeps GAP-04 BLOCKED.

gaps.title: CAN and LIN transceiver selection and physical interface evidence
gaps.source_owner: REP-03 hardware decision owner and client

closure_criteria.requirement: Approve exact CAN and LIN transceiver manufacturer part numbers and variant-to-part mapping.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Approved BOM or signed project decision plus versioned manufacturer datasheets and errata, all referenceable and SHA-256 pinned.

closure_criteria.requirement: Map supply, logic-level, standby, wake, dominant-state, bus-fault, temperature, protection, and timing limits into the affected contracts without guessed values.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Every adopted value must cite page or section, source version, unit, tolerance, and applicability. Conflicts remain BLOCKED.

closure_criteria.requirement: Pass closed-schema regression and independent source review after the contracts are updated.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Automated tests and review record must pass; source closure alone does not claim bench, EMC, ISO, or vehicle validation.

physical_claim_limit.statement: Controller/UART and synthetic state-machine results do not prove a physical transceiver, bus, harness, protection network, EMC performance, or vehicle suitability.

gaps.title: GNSS module, antenna, RF feed, and layout evidence
gaps.source_owner: REP-03 RF decision owner and client

closure_criteria.requirement: Approve the exact GNSS module/revision and antenna type/part with compatible frequency, bias, connector, and power requirements.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Approved BOM or signed project decision plus versioned manufacturer datasheet and integration guide, all referenceable and SHA-256 pinned.

closure_criteria.requirement: Document the RF feed, impedance, matching, ground/keep-out, placement, cable, and ESD constraints against authoritative sections.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Project RF review must map each constraint to a source page or section and preserve unresolved items as BLOCKED.

closure_criteria.requirement: Update the GNSS source matrix and pass closed-schema, source-integrity, and independent review checks.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Synthetic fix-quality tests may pass separately; RF suitability cannot pass until the required sources and project review pass.

physical_claim_limit.statement: A synthetically valid fix does not prove module integration, RF-feed quality, antenna gain, placement, sensitivity, accuracy, EMC performance, or field reception.

gaps.title: OEM automotive transient profile and exact power-path evidence
gaps.source_owner: Client or vehicle OEM requirement owner and REP-03 power decision owner

closure_criteria.requirement: Obtain approved nominal, cold-crank, brownout, jump-start, suppressed and unsuppressed load-dump, ignition, and recovery profiles with applicability and tolerances.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Client/OEM or approved vehicle requirement must be versioned, referenceable, and SHA-256 pinned; generic application notes cannot substitute.

closure_criteria.requirement: Approve exact regulator and protection-path parts and map absolute maximum, operating range, current limit, switching, efficiency, inductor, capacitor derating, PGOOD, inrush, back-power, sequencing, and thermal limits.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Manufacturer datasheets and errata must be pinned by version and SHA-256; adopted values must cite page or section and include unit and tolerance.

closure_criteria.requirement: Update the power contract, verify the REP-02 integration input, and pass closed-schema and independent source review.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: A contract or adapter PASS is not electrical simulation, bench, transient, EMC, ISO, AEC, thermal, or vehicle validation.

physical_claim_limit.statement: Current profiles are contract test vectors, not measured waveforms. No regulator, protection network, transient survival, sequencing, thermal, EMC, ISO, AEC, or vehicle claim is permitted.

gaps.title: Raspberry Pi model and host shutdown and ACK contract
gaps.source_owner: Client and REP-03 host-integration decision owner

closure_criteria.requirement: Approve the exact Raspberry Pi model/revision, supported power path, rail/current limits, boot/shutdown behavior, and any back-power constraints.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Client decision and applicable platform-manufacturer sources must be versioned, referenceable, and SHA-256 pinned.

closure_criteria.requirement: Approve the host shutdown protocol including trigger, command owner, ACK definition, timeout, retry, missing/stuck ACK handling, logging, fail-safe action, and final power-off order.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: Client and host-software owner approval is required. The local task plan supplies workflow semantics only and cannot satisfy this criterion by itself.

closure_criteria.requirement: Implement WF-03-06 as a host-independent synthetic FSM and pass normal ACK, missing or late ACK, early cut, duplicate ACK, ignition bounce, rapid restart, missing protocol, closed-schema, and malformed-input tests.
closure_criteria.evidence_rule: The 24 October 2026 Session 4 record proves only the synthetic software-contract portion. Hardware timing, back-power behavior, power-down order, and safe physical power removal still require approved sources and physical verification.

physical_claim_limit.statement: A synthetic ACK or shutdown trace does not prove operating-system completion, storage integrity, rail discharge, absence of back-power, safe power removal, or hardware timing.
